title: Unveiling 2025 Design Trends From Cersaie Fair, Italy
bodyHtml:
Bologna, Italy Recap!

We’re back from Cersaie in Bologna, Italy—one of the world’s most exciting and influential events for ceramic tiles and bathroom furnishings!

This year’s exhibition was nothing short of inspiring, and we had the incredible opportunity to immerse ourselves in the latest design trends and state-of-the-art technology that is shaping the future of bathroom design for 2025 and beyond.

Read on to see what our Design Team discovered..

Softened Profiles

Ceramic products, including basins, baths, and toilets, are embracing fuller, more rounded edges—a notable shift from the sharper / thin walled designs that have dominated the past decade. This marks an exciting evolution towards softer, more inviting shapes.

The Rise of Gloss Colour

Continuing the momentum we noticed earlier this year at Salone, Milan, glossy finishes in both bold and soft tones are gaining significant traction. This refreshing palette is reshaping the colour design trend for bathrooms, offering a diverse range of vibrant and calming hues.

The Silent Flush Revolution

The vortex or tornado flush is taking centre stage in the toilet space thanks to it's minimalist bowl aesthetic and silent operation. As more time passes, manufacturers have refined this cutting-edge technology, delivering enhanced flushing systems that offer increased power, efficiency, and improved design.

Fluted Finishes Still Hot!

The fluted look—whether on basins, baths, or vanities — remains a defining trend. Its texture adds depth and dimension to bathroom surfaces, maintaining its popularity well into 2025.

Natural Textures

We saw a strong presence of stone and natural textures, especially in bathroom furniture. This adds a tactile, grounded quality to bathroom spaces, making them feel closer to nature and more organic.

Thanks for Reading!

We’re excited to share how these trends have already begun shaping and integrating into our 2025 Collection. Stay tuned as we get closer to the release!
